body:
I think JavaScript doesn’t support character class ranges without the end of the range being explicit, so I’d change both occurrences of `[\u0080-]` into `[\x80-\u{10FFFF}]`.

Is `[A-Za-z-.:_\u0080-]` meant to refer to step 4? In that case, it’s missing “ASCII digits”. Suggestion: `[A-Za-z0-9-.:_\x80-\u{10FFFF}]`.

- Valid namespace prefix: `[\0\t\n\f\r />]`
- Valid attribute local name: `[\0\t\n\f\r /=>]`
- Valid element local name, step 2.1: `[^\0\t\n\f\r />]`
- Valid element local name, step 3: `[:_\x80-\u{10FFFF}]`
- Valid element local name, step 4: `[A-Za-z0-9-.:_\x80-\u{10FFFF}]`

Piecing things together:

```js
/^(?:[A-Za-z][^\0\t\n\f\r\x20/>]*)|(?:[:_\x80-\u{10FFFF}][A-Za-z0-9-.:_\x80-\u{10FFFF}]*)$/u
```
